correctness.rationale: Checked both actual reduct operations: a↔b=top on equality and min otherwise, and a ~∧ b=top iff both positive, else zero. The scalar nonconstant maps fix bottom/top, have strictly increasing intermediate surviving prefix into intermediate target positions, then collapse to top, counted by sum binom(n-2,k). Two active source-coordinate restrictions violate 0↔0=top vs 0 ~∧0=bottom using cross-coordinate embeddings of bottom; ↔ decomposition establishes unique one-coordinate dependence. Bijective scalars on an equal chain are identity, giving S_r. Idempotent arrows must point to fixed-point loop roots of prefix-retractions; compatible labels count w_{m,p}, giving the stated forest/star sum and labeled exponential formula. Independently exhausted scalar maps for 2<=m,n<=4 by actual two-operation tables (counts m=n=4: 5); inspected bundled independent verify.py covering mixed product maps, idempotents and finite EGF coefficients. Finite checks support but do not substitute for universal proof.
